hypothesis: Warm stochastic execution requires independent fixed and per-row features. An explicitly nonzero baseline combined with penalty-row cardinality may improve attribution for greedy calls while preserving those features and the compilation indicator.

pcvs.name: baseline_and_penalty_rows
pcvs.rationale: Provides an explicit nonzero baseline for every call plus the number of rows receiving penalties.

pcvs.name: random_rows
pcvs.rationale: Captures stochastic work proportional to batch size.

pcvs.rationale: Separates initial compilation from subsequent sampling.
